text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's summer vacation! ♪ What, you think I'm not going to train? Of course, I am! Train hard, play hard!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …Hm? What's that I sense watching me from up in trees? Is it some kind of critter? Or perhaps…
